expected_level_description: You can: - lead clinical professional standards for the organisation's digital work - act as a senior clinical voice in decisions about patient safety and care - support the revalidation and professional development of clinicians in digital roles

You can: - set the clinical direction for the organisation's digital services - lead clinical leaders across organisations through digital change - advise the board on clinical risk and benefit of digital investment

You can: - own the clinical risk management system for the organisation - set clinical safety policy and assure safety cases for major systems - lead the response to serious safety incidents involving health IT - build a culture of clinical safety across digital teams

You can: - set the organisation's approach to digital health evaluation - lead research and evaluation programmes with academic and care partners - use evidence to advise the board on digital investment

You can: - shape organisational strategy using a deep understanding of the health and care system - represent the organisation with health and care partners and leaders - anticipate how policy and service changes will affect digital services and care

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
You can: - lead the design and implementation of strategy, directing the evaluation of strategies and policies to ensure business requirements are being met

You can: - change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs - lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis - make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity - build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders - solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level - understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills - coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution
